name: Archery range
about: Three targets on hay bales, and a gravel line to shoot from.

layers.name: Shooting line
layers.tip: On flat grass, swap the front row for gravel. That is where you stand.

layers.name: Hay bales
layers.tip: Three hay bales along the back, with a gap between each. A barrel on the gravel holds your arrows. Fence posts at the ends of the line hold torches.

layers.name: Targets
layers.tip: A target on each hay bale, and a torch on each post. Make a target from a hay bale and redstone.
